links.comparator_used: Professor vs Specialist vs Resident role prompts (no no-role baseline)
links.outcome: Accuracy on PES orthopedics and traumatology exams across role prompts
links.effect: Overall accuracy 81% (range 68.33%-85.83%); highest score 85.83% recorded multiple times across different prompt types; agreement between prompting strategies moderate to substantial (Cohen's κ 0.518-0.632; Fleiss' κ = 0.571)
links.quote: The highest score (85.83%) was recorded multiple times across different prompt types, indicating that the model could approach or exceed the minimum passing threshold depending on prompt structure.
